title: Nine dated Hanford observations now attach to exact lifecycle stages and operators
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy Hanford Field Office and Washington State Department of Ecology
summary: The registry stores nine bounded observations, including greater-than thresholds, exact counts, an approximate count, and milestone events, without assuming that feed-volume and container-stage observations share one cohort. Denominator: Nine source-attributed observations across AP-106 staging, acceptable-glass startup, container fill or handling, shipment, IDF staging, and disposal.
